name: FixMySlop
description: The slop linter for the AI-agent era: catch AI slop in UI and code in milliseconds, then let your agent fix it.

paragraphs: The slop linter for the AI-agent era. FixMySlop catches the things AI coding agents get wrong — the purple-gradient landing page, the // ... existing code ... that silently deleted half a file, the npm package that doesn't exist, the OpenAI key in NEXTPUBLIC — in milliseconds, without an LLM. Then it hands a precise fix list to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini) and re-scans to prove it's fixed.
Try it without installing: paste any public GitHub repo at fix-my-slop.vercel.app.

Frontier models are great at fixing slop and bad at noticing their own. They write the purple gradient because it's the statistical default; they elide code when an edit gets long; they import packages that sound right. FixMySlop is the other half of the loop:
